description: Pak-Qatar General Takaful Limited is a Pakistani general takaful operator and part of the Pak-Qatar Takaful Group, which also includes Pak-Qatar Family Takaful Limited and Pak-Qatar Asset Management Company. It provides Shariah-compliant general takaful cover — general insurance written on takaful principles, with the operator managing a waqf fund on behalf of participants — under the oversight of a Shariah advisory board.
